title: ASCII export of surface/volume data
interactive: /file/export/ascii → file name → surface list (…) → () → yes → field list → () → yes
notes: Verified on the user's real runs (start.sh/start.sh.template). The first line of the file is a header, the separator is a comma. The meaning of the `()` literals and the second `yes` is not explained in the help (requires_verification); with a wrong number of arguments the journal aborts. Internal field names: temperature, velocity-magnitude, x-velocity, y-velocity, pressure, density, specific-heat-cp, thermal-conductivity-lam, viscosity-lam, heat-flux.
